faq.q: What song plays as Jason walks toward Andrés in GTA 6?
faq.a: "Mine O' Mine," a 2022 house collaboration between Aluna and Jayda G, plays there. It runs from roughly 21:55 to 22:53 in the Netflix Extended Look, as Jason exits an elevator and walks toward a conference room to meet Andrés.

faq.q: Who made Mine O' Mine in GTA 6?
faq.a: Aluna and Jayda G, who released the house track on April 26, 2022. GameRant documented its placement in the GTA VI Netflix Extended Look.

faq.a: House music. The record describes it as a 2022 collaboration between Aluna and Jayda G, heard as Jason walks toward a meeting with Andrés.

faq.q: Who is Andrés in the Mine O' Mine scene?
faq.a: He is a character Jason walks to meet in a conference room during this song. The record does not give further detail about who he is.
